output.content: I am checking the logs for the weekly model performance audit. The pipeline runs the standard accuracy checks on the validation set every Monday morning at 02:00. The output file lands in the shared bucket by 02:15. I open the dashboard to review the feature distribution plots. The section labeled drift status is blank. There are no charts for the last thirty days. The system does not flag any anomalies because the monitoring module is not installed in the production cluster. I scroll down to the raw data export. The timestamps are sequential and complete. The file size matches the expected record count for the week. I close the browser tab and move to the next service. The next service has the same empty section.
